title: Fresh Bar 50/50 Fresh Menthol Mojito 10ml E-Liquid By Pukka Juice
description: Fresh Menthol Mojito from Fresh Bar is a zingy, zesty, tastebud-tingling cocktail of Fresh Mint, sunny Lime and bubbly Soda that offers a more sophisticated and flavoursome take on fresh e-liquid flavours like Menthol and Mint. It’s crisp, bright mint and sweet lime blend is light and refreshing in all the right ways. This delicious 50:50 E-Liquid from Fresh Bar offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. This type of e-liquid hits the sweet spot of plenty of flavour and impressive cloud production and work well in almost every type of vape kit, making it the most versatile type of e-liquid at Vapestore. 50:50 e-liquids typically contain traditional Freebase nicotine, which offers the classic e-liquid experience. With Freebase e-liquids, the flavours are often more intense with a stronger, more tactile throat hit than you would find with nicotine salts, or high-VG e-liquids. This makes them a great choice for newer vapers seeking that familiar ‘smoking’ sensation. Fresh Bar are a brand of e-liquids from vape masters Pukka Juice, an award-winning UK e-liquid company behind some of the most popular e-liquids today. From nic salts, to 50/50 e-liquids, Fresh Bar e-liquids draw inspiration from the most popular disposable vape bar flavours.
